sections.What this covers: Every offering the consortium makes, every service behind it, and how they connect. What a service does in detail belongs to that service's record. The path a jacket image takes belongs to [exp-covers-path](covers-path.md).
sections.Where the detail lives:
* [ofr-discovery](../offerings/discovery.md), [ofr-borrowing](../offerings/borrowing.md) and [ofr-reservations](../offerings/reservations.md) say what a borrower can do, and which services do it.
* [svc-catalogue-web](../services/catalogue-web.md) and [svc-catalogue-api](../services/catalogue-api.md) describe the public site and its gateway.
* [svc-reservations](../services/reservations.md) describes the reserve-and-pay site, and [svc-covers-cdn](../services/covers-cdn.md) the jacket imagery.
* [svc-lending](../services/lending.md) describes the strangler wrapper and the legacy database behind it. [dat-loans](../data/loans.md) and [dat-borrowers](../data/borrowers.md)
  describe the data it reads and writes.
* [svc-search](../services/search.md), [svc-notices](../services/notices.md) and [svc-shelf-audit](../services/shelf-audit.md) describe the work that runs on a schedule or on an event.
* [Services](../services.md) states the conventions this catalogue follows, and why some coupling has no edge.
* [exp-covers-path](covers-path.md) walks the path a jacket image takes, through [svc-thumbnailer](../services/thumbnailer.md).
